tagline: Founder of a boutique consultancy with high-value client data
description: Robert lacks a dedicated IT department and needs a 'set-it-and-forget-it' security solution to protect sensitive client intellectual property.
rationale: This persona represents an underserved segment that requires low-touch onboarding and simplified UI, according to recent churn surveys.
